title: Brooklyn building collapse: Pregnant woman rescued from rubble
text:
Brooklyn building collapse: Pregnant woman rescued from rubble - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut Pregnant woman rescued from Brooklyn collapse rubble, husband says 
 By Krista McNally Thursday, November 12, 2026 12:57PM 
 Krista McNally has more on the recovery efforts. WABC FLATBUSH, Brooklyn (WABC) -- A 6-month-pregnant woman was pulled alive from the rubble of a collapsed building , prompting an emotional reaction from her husband as first responders continued rescue efforts Wednesday night.
 A man was seen embracing another person, and crying after learning that his wife had survived the collapse and been removed from the debris.
 "I have an update. She is alive, she is still alive. I am very happy," the man said.
 Earlier in the evening, the man had run down Flatbush Avenue searching for his wife.
 A pregnant woman may have been pulled from rubble after a building partially collapsed in Brooklyn. 
 He attempted to get past law enforcement officers to reach her but was moved to a safe area away from the collapsed building so first responders could continue rescue efforts and reach victims as quickly as possible.
 The man stood outside the scene pleading for help and desperately seeking information about his pregnant wife.
 "I've heard nothing. She's inside the building. She's pregnant," the man told police and Eyewitness News as emergency crews continued their search operations.
 Krista McNally spoke to a husband who believes his pregnant wife is trapped in the partial building collapse on Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn 
 At about 6:30 p.m., the man received the news he had been desperately awaiting. His wife was found alive, placed on a stretcher and taken by ambulance for medical treatment.
 After learning she had survived, the man expressed gratitude to those involved in the rescue.
 "I'm very happy. I want to thank all of you guys," he said.
 The identities of the man and his wife were not immediately known. They were rushed from the scene so she could receive medical attention.
 It was at least one positive outcome to a night that was steeped in tragedy.
 The collapse happened shortly after 4 p.m. when a three-story building at 1321 Flatbush Ave. collapsed into a neighboring construction site at 2625 Bedford Ave., officials said.
 The death toll rose to 8 early Thursday and at least 17 others injured , according to officials. Of the injured, FDNY officials said four are in critical condition, 12 are stable, and one firefighter is being treated for minor injuries. Seven children were among those treated.

 Rescue crews spent hours combing through the debris as they worked to locate anyone who might still be trapped.
 NewsCopter 7 footage showed catastrophic damage, with large sections of the building reduced to rubble. The collapse also damaged a neighboring building at 1323 Flatbush Ave., where part of the exterior appeared sheared away, exposing apartments inside. That building remained standing.
 Operations are ongoing.
